variants.idea: Remove several givens spread across rows, columns and boxes to cut easy singles and force longer deduction chains.
Remove givens in the middle and right columns so the repeating-pattern solution is harder to read off.
Remove givens that make the 8s and 2s in the top and middle easy to place.
Fewer givens in the lower right and top middle, so more cells need multi-step elimination.
Open up the center columns and row 4, which was already error-prone, so fewer cells can be filled immediately.
Scatter removals across many units so no row, column or box is close to complete.
